measurement_context: Cosmos3 Edge policy server on physical GPU 0 while the RoboLab Isaac Sim confirmation client ran on physical GPU 1. This is a live steady-state snapshot during a policy request, not a maximum-memory measurement.

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090
gpus.role: Cosmos3 Edge DROID policy server with video decoding

driver_workaround: Isaac Sim's Vulkan parser displayed 535.53.01 because the three-digit driver minor overflowed its field, so the run used --/rtx/verifyDriverVersion/enabled=false after host nvidia-smi verified 535.309.01. The rejected startup produced no policy requests and is excluded separately.
